description: Registered redirect-URI matching over additional boundary inputs: a loopback match on a differing port, an IPv6 loopback match on a differing port, selection among multiple registered URIs, a custom scheme exact match, a registered entry carrying a fragment, and a port-differing non-loopback-style comparison. For each check the output reports the resolved URI or a neutral mismatch error.

cases.expected_output:
redirect_uri=http://127.0.0.1:1/cb
redirect_uri=http://[::1]:9999/path
redirect_uri=https://b.com/cb
redirect_uri=app://cb
error=redirect_uri_mismatch
redirect_uri=http://127.0.0.1:9090/cb
